title: Leader
desc: Arjun, a politician, is the new leader of his political party, as he strives to navigate multiple challenges to eliminate corruption.

title: Raghavendra Stores
desc: Hayavadana and his wife go to a resort on a holiday. However, when they encounter politicians over there, chaos ensues, as they strive to save their friend, who gets in trouble with the ministers.

title: Chikku
desc: Eshwar, aka Chikku, is devastated when his precious niece goes missing. Subsequently, he embarks on a relentless pursuit to find her, testing the boundaries of love.

title: Kranthiveera Sangolli Rayanna
desc: Sangolli Rayanna, the army chief of the Kingdom of Kittur and a freedom fighter, revolts against the British in a bid to oust them from the country.

title: Mangalavaaram
desc: Maaya becomes the new sub-inspector of a village gripped by mysterious murders. But as she begins to investigate, she uncovers a web of dark truths and conspiracies.

title: Ananthu V/S Nusrath
desc: Ananthu, a lawyer from a traditional Brahmin family, falls for Nusrath, a judge from a different faith, leading to a heartfelt journey of love, family expectations and courtroom drama.

title: Gandhada Gudi
desc: When forest officer Kumar protects natural resources from poachers, their boss, Anand, becomes his main rival. But little does Kumar know that Anand is his brother.

title: Shiva Shakthi
desc: Tarakasura seeks Shukracharya's blessings for war against Lord Shiva, but Shukracharya warns of dire consequences. Will Tarakasura heed the warning or proceed with his plans?

title: Kaamannana Makkalu
desc: With the help of his two sons, Kaamanna, a former thief, decides to start a new life on the right side of the law.
